name: Nuwa #64 — Phoenix of Creation and Harmony
title: Nuwa, Serpent of Divine Balance
description: Nuwa, Serpent of Divine Balance — the 64th phoenix reincarnation. A celestial phoenix goddess whose lower body flows into a serpent’s tail, symbol of eternal creation. Her plumage glows in jade and gold, wings spread in harmonious balance. In one hand she wields a radiant spear of divine order, in the other — a golden celestial ring binding heaven and earth. Silent and eternal, she forges life from darkness, weaving balance between fire and stillness. Ultra-detailed 8K anime-realism, HDR10+ cinematic lighting, pure black background with a reserved lower black zone for the NFT banner.
